_note: The hole's milestones (F-005): one list, tracked per hole with the day each was reached, saved. check is population (at least `at` people), born (at least `at` children born), floors (at least `at` floors dug), harvest (at least `at` crops grown, all told: grow time isn't modelled, so this is about a farm's first day), grownUp (at least `at` children grown up here), generation (a child of generation `at` born: arrivals are the first, children of arrivals the second), passedAway (at least `at` elders passed away), fullRing (every slot of one floor's ring dug, not counting the rings the landing crew blasted out), domed or closedLoop (over the last whole month, treatment put back into `loop` more than the loop lost for good: each room's water taken beyond what it returned, plus overflow; sim/milestones.ts); event milestones are reached only by an event's `celebrate` effect (data/events.json). celebrate: true also proposes a celebration (events.json `celebrations`), one at a time. title fills {title} in `reached` (the news) and {milestone} on the celebration card. hint says how to get there, in the milestones panel. group sorts them for the panel, in this order. Older saves mark what they've already passed as reached, day unknown, without news.
